## Problem

What incorrect, missing, or inconvenient behavior is being addressed?

## Solution

What changed at the behavior and architecture level?

## Why this approach

Why this option? What important alternatives were considered?

## Out of scope

What related work is intentionally excluded?

## Risks

What can break? Include migration, compatibility, security, performance, or
rollout risks when relevant.

## Verification

What automated and manual checks were run?

## References

Issue, documentation, or related pull request.

## Scope Check

- [ ] The change stays within the stated scope.
- [ ] The work was done on a scoped branch, not directly on the stable branch.
- [ ] No direct stable-branch commit, merge, or push was used unless a process exception is documented.
- [ ] Out-of-scope follow-ups were left out of this PR.
- [ ] Relevant docs and ADRs were checked.
- [ ] PR title follows `<type>(<scope>): <description>` using an approved scope.
- [ ] Non-trivial squash commit body will explain why, what, approach, risks, and references.

## Verification

- [ ] Checks, builds, tests, or manual verification were run.
- [ ] Any skipped verification is explained below.
- [ ] Full diff self-review was completed for non-trivial work.

Verification notes:

-

## Project Memory

- [ ] Docs were updated if behavior, architecture, scope, workflow, or project memory changed.
- [ ] `OPEN_QUESTIONS.md` was updated if new unresolved questions appeared.
- [ ] ADR was added or updated if an important decision was made.
